notes:
Passed on the fake backend by `python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/yitianshi__metaisaacgrasp --backend fake` (evidence contract_checked; simulated R0; model-authored and unreviewed; reviewed_by is null; no hardware run and no human review or test is claimed). Scope: the AIR-v0-Data environment of the clone, entry class isaac_env.air_env_data:AIREnvData. The other card entry symbols (AIREnvGrasp, AIREnvTele, AIREnvSB3, AIREnvRL) and the other registered ids are other configurations/devices and are not covered; the SB3 and Tele registrations name modules that do not define the named class (air_env_sb3/__init__.py:28, air_env_tele/__init__.py:28), and the grasp package binds localhost:8081 and waits for a remote agent at import (air_env_grasp/element_cfg.py:11-25). Mock path: the card's preferred upstream-sim path was not run because it needs Isaac Sim 4.5 and Isaac Lab 2.0 and a GPU (README.md:1, :55-57); the fake backend is the package's pure Python kinematic stand-in, not a recording and not the upstream environment. The sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. The fake implements only the Gymnasium surface (action_space, observation_space, reset, step, close): 7 action values (six arm joints plus the binary gripper term) with an unbounded Box because the clone states no action bounds, and 14 observation values reduced to the camera pose and the end-effector pose. NOT COVERED: the policy group's rgb, normals, instance_segmentation_fast, distance_to_image_plane and pcd arrays; their configured size is 480 x 640 per camera (element_cfg.py:63). The fake is kinematic (no physics, contacts, friction, gravity, actuators, sensors, noise or rendering), applies placeholder joint-target increments, truncates at STEP_TOTAL 30 and returns a fixed reward 0.0; all such numbers are marked '# placeholder' in fake.py and none was copied into a Fact, a Limit or the reference. The upstream AIREnvBase.step takes a grasp pose and loops until its policy inference criteria (air_env_base/env.py:276), which is not a single Gymnasium transition; that mismatch is stated in fidelity.gaps. The fidelity contract is F0 (kinematic) with engine isaaclab:AIR-v0-Data (Isaac Sim 4.5 / Isaac Lab 2.0), timestep_ms 1000/60, realtime_factor 0, clock lockstep and snapshot_restore false. Warnings, all expected or explained: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x4 for action_space, observation_space, reset and close, which the ManagerBasedRLEnv base outside the clone provides; G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived ticks, action.values and two seed inputs; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the clone states no finite action bound and none was invented, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe and the suite awards CL2. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
